description:
**TSP iterated local search with double-bridge perturbation.** The input is a symmetric complete distance matrix. The result is an open tour with the closing edge implicit. Nearest-neighbor construction supplies the first tour to best-improvement 2-opt.

Each iteration applies a double-bridge perturbation to the incumbent and passes the entire perturbed order to 2-opt. Replace the incumbent only when the locally improved cost is lower. A seeded generator and a finite round count control perturbations.

The combination revisits local optima using four changed edges, without a cached position array from the earlier tour. Below eight vertices the perturbation returns a copy. The loop is an independent small ILS variant with strict improvement acceptance.
